name: keepupdated
description: Inspect software on an Apple Silicon Mac and preview updates or uninstalls with native confirmation.

interface.longDescription: Inspect applications, Skills, MCP configurations, packages and runtimes on macOS 13 or later with Apple Silicon. Preview supported updates or uninstalls, approve the exact plan in a native window, and inspect saved results. Unsupported or privileged actions remain blocked or manual. Local candidate; not notarized.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Mac software and show me what can be updated.
